data.naming_authority: The German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv) Halle-Jena-Leipzig
data.title: Protected areas (BES-SIM 2 GLOBIO, 0.5 degree)
data.summary:
Protection status of land expressed as suitability for land use change from the GLOBIO model. This
    version is aggregated to a 0.5 degree spatial resolution for the BES-SIM 2 Nature Futures scenarios.
data.source: Protected area maps expressed as the suitability for land use change from the GLOBIO model

publisher.publisher_institution: German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv)

ebv_entity.ebv_entity_type: Protection as suitability for LU change
ebv_entity.ebv_entity_scope: This dataset contains the protection status of land as the suitability for land use change. Protection corresponds to a suitability value of 0.

ebv_metric_1.:long_name: Land protection records whether a grid cell is suitable for land use change. Original raster values are 0 (protection), 95 and 100. In this 0.5 degree product, values represent the mean aggregated suitability across all input cells.

ebv_scenario.ebv_scenario_classification_name: The scenarios were built based on the values of nature outlined in the Nature Futures Framework for BES-SIM 2. Protection only applies to NfN and NfS.

data.comment: 0.5 degree mean-aggregated version of the original GLOBIO-based protected area suitability rasters.
